title: RetailAnalytics AdSpendStoreSales

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the retail analytics research task. Analyzed 3 years of monthly store-level data (200 stores × 36 months = 7,200 observations) to optimize ad spend allocation. Key findings: 1) Diminishing returns during holidays (ROI 27:1 vs 47:1 for non-holidays), 2) Store-level ad effectiveness varies 1.8×, 3) Current policy explains only 24.4% of ad spend variance. Developed predictive models (R² > 0.995) and created optimization framework with store efficiency tiers and monthly adjustment factors. Recommended changes could improve ROI by ~5%, generating estimated $36M additional annual sales. Delivered comprehensive report with 5 figures, analysis code, and implementation roadmap.
